title: Make two status labels into one line of equal width
goal: uses inline-block to allow inline labels to set width and height.
summary: The text length of the entry status is different. The existing width and height do not take effect, and the two prompts need to use the same width background.
tasks: Set the display of .entry-tag to inline-block.
retains 108px width and 34px height, leaving "Check in" and "Ready" equal width side by side.

example.note: The rating label can be arranged in one line with the text before and after it, and at the same time, press width to leave a fixed width.

hint: display: block makes the width effective, but subsequent labels will wrap. To use width and height and maintain inline alignment, select inline-block.
